Q4 launch of TranscripTx™ genetic test

Verici Dx Plc, (AIM: VRCI), a developer of advanced clinical diagnostics for organ transplant, announces it will be launching TranscripTx™, a first-in-class genetic test specifically designed for the transplant community, in Q4 2026.

TranscripTx™ is an innovative genetic test designed to identify key variations in a person’s genes that are known to impact biological processes relevant to transplant patients. These variations, known as polymorphisms or genetic variants, can assist in patient management by informing clinicians about the way a transplant recipient may respond to therapy or may help assess their long-term risk of graft failure. This information may help accelerate new drug development, inform ongoing clinical trials, and ultimately, improve medical management protocols.

The test uses next-generation sequencing to measure genetic variants found in peripheral blood RNA. TranscripTx™ will be offered as a laboratory developed test (‘LDT’) in Verici’s CLIA-certified, CAP accredited laboratory.

TranscripTx™ incorporates AI-enabled evidence-based gene selection specifically tailored to transplant. The genes are backed by peer-reviewed literature1 to provide clinically meaningful insights, and it is the only multi-gene panel developed specifically for transplant recipients. Leveraging Verici’s deep expertise in RNA diagnostics, the test will also be capable of detecting clinically-relevant genetic splice variants that are impossible to detect using cell-free DNA technologies.

TranscripTx™ demonstrates the strategic value of Verici’s extensive repository of clinical data and biological samples to rapidly perform retrospective analyses and commercialise new diagnostic products.

1 Nobakht E, Jagadeesan M, Paul R, Bromberg J, Dadgar S. Precision Medicine in Kidney Transplantation: Just Hype or a Realistic Hope? Transplant Direct. 2021 Jan 7;7(2):e650. doi: 10.1097/TXD.0000000000001102. PMID: 33437865; PMCID: PMC7793397.

Sara Barrington, CEO of Verici Dx, commented: "With TranscripTx™, we are translating cutting-edge RNA science into actionable intelligence and providing the research community with an unprecedented level of biological insight. This launch translates our robust data repository into a tangible, multi-gene asset that will push the boundaries of precision medicine. This test underscores our commitment to pioneering personalised diagnostics in transplantation, maximising the strategic value of our clinical data while offering a vital new resource for therapeutic development and patient care."
Singer Capital Markets (Nominated adviser, Joint Broker)

Verici Dx plc (AIM: VRCI) is a precision diagnostics company transforming care for transplant patients. The company combines multiomic analysis with proprietary artificial intelligence to deliver predictive, actionable, data-driven intelligence that reflects the complexity and heterogeneity of transplant patients, enabling clinicians to optimise therapy, guide biopsy decisions, and stratify risk with greater confidence.

Operating at the intersection of laboratory and data science, Verici Dx develops complex models that answer the clinical questions that matter most with unrivaled clarity and precision. All tests are built to rigorous scientific standards, validated across inclusive, and real-world patient populations to ensure clinical relevance and reliability. Verici Dx’s lead product, Tutivia®, is a post-kidney transplant test focused on early detection of acute rejection.
The company is UK headquartered in Cardiff for the UK, and in Franklin, Tennessee for the U.S.
